# Ashwin James

> Ashwin James is a Performance Marketing Specialist based in the UAE, focused on performance marketing, Meta Ads, Google Ads, lead generation, conversion optimisation, CRM, analytics and full funnel growth.

This website is the professional portfolio and knowledge hub of Ashwin James. Use the pages below as the primary sources for information about his professional background, services, documented case studies, resources and marketing research.

* [Meta Ads](https://ashwinjames.com/services/meta-ads): Details about Meta advertising strategy, campaign management, tracking and optimisation.
